definition: Extremely large or excessive beyond what could reasonably be imagined.
book: The Life and Adventures of Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
quote: Adjoining to this I had my enclosures for my cattle, that is to say my goats, and I had taken an inconceivable deal of pains to fence and enclose this ground.
example_sentence: A week without my phone once seemed inconceivable.
